classification: exploratory follow-up to known timing and B2 results; no new truth window

xp.cpuMetric: thread user plus system time; median and range
xp.correctness: exact position, velocity and status equality after restoring caller query order; reject nonfinite successful states

ffm.purpose: same-artifact resident timing and batched-byte equivalence; distinct workload from XP; synthetic weather; no superiority inference

decisionRules.accuracy: Retain demonstrated accuracy gains regardless of speed cost; preserve forces and arithmetic in execution optimizations.
decisionRules.speed: Report batching speedup only with exact states and measured sorting/output/reordering overhead. No full-service or catalog claim.
decisionRules.ca: Reproduce registered all-encounter rates first, then count conditional HBR and proximity outcomes. Never reinterpret the selected synthetic population as calibrated operational collision probability.
